categories.main_business_segments: Dongguan Yutong Optical Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of optical lens products. Its primary business segments include security surveillance lenses, automotive optical lenses, smart home optical products, machine vision lenses, and other high-precision optical systems such as video conferencing and medical imaging. The company also operates in emerging fields like automotive HUD (Head-Up Display), LiDAR optical components, and micro-single camera lenses.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced optical design, including large aperture, low distortion, and night vision technologies. It employs a mix of glass and plastic aspherical lenses, precision molding, and coating technologies. Manufacturing methods include in-house production with some outsourced processing for low value-added components. The company has developed proprietary technologies such as optical-thermal co-simulation, high-precision metal prism processing, and freeform curved glass mirrors for automotive HUD systems. It also maintains a CNAS-certified testing laboratory with advanced inspection and reliability testing equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading security surveillance companies like Hikvision and Dahua, major automotive manufacturers such as BYD, Geely, Toyota, Volkswagen, and Great Wall Motors, as well as clients in smart home, machine vision, and consumer electronics sectors. The company serves markets in public security, intelligent driving (ADAS and autonomous driving), smart home automation, machine vision for industrial automation, and emerging fields like medical optics and infrared thermal imaging.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant domestic sales, accounting for over 88% of revenue, and is actively expanding its overseas presence, especially in Southeast Asia, South Asia, and South America. It has established a production subsidiary in Thailand to support international market expansion. The company also serves global customers in automotive and security sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Dongguan Yutong Optical Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the optical lens supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of optical lenses and components. It procures raw materials and components from upstream suppliers and sells finished optical products directly to downstream customers in various end markets. The company also engages in some outsourcing for low value-added manufacturing processes.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with a strong R&D focus on large aperture lenses, night vision fish-eye lenses, automotive optical components including LiDAR and HUD, machine vision lenses, and micro-single camera lenses. It invests heavily in developing high-resolution, low-distortion, and high-reliability optical systems. The R&D strategy includes expanding product lines in automotive optics, smart home, medical optics, and infrared thermal imaging, while enhancing production capabilities and pursuing domestic substitution of key optical materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the direct sale of optical lens products and related components. The company operates a direct sales model both domestically and internationally, engaging customers through exhibitions, direct visits, and sample testing. It also benefits from government subsidies and investment income, but the core revenue stream is product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the world's largest manufacturer of security surveillance lenses, holding the top market share for over ten consecutive years. It competes with other optical lens manufacturers serving security, automotive, and industrial vision markets. In automotive optics, it ranks third globally in car lens shipments. Its competitive advantages include scale economies, comprehensive product lines, strong customer relationships with industry leaders, and continuous technological innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 2.74 billion, representing a 27.9% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders surged by 494.92% to RMB 183.56 million. The company has total assets exceeding RMB 5.3 billion and net assets of RMB 2.4 billion, showing steady growth and expanding scale. R&D investment increased by over 41%, reflecting a strong growth trajectory driven by innovation and market expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dongguan Yutong Optical Technology emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced optical lenses with superior imaging performance, including large aperture, high resolution, low distortion, and night vision capabilities. Its products are tailored for demanding applications in security, automotive safety, and industrial automation. The company differentiates itself through proprietary technologies, extensive patent portfolio, rigorous quality control, and strong customer service, enabling it to maintain leadership in key markets and foster long-term partnerships with top-tier clients.
